lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Wow, it's been a while since we've had a story this explosive.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Anis of T.T. STAR has just turned the former chart-topping singer, Yoyo, into...

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Well, mush.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: Not something you see often these days.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Sounds like these two go way back, even from before they were Nikkes... So how'd it end up turning into a full-blown showdown in front of a crowd?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: You're aware T.T. STAR's manager died, right?

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Oh yeah, she caused quite a scene during the Smile Time project, and the forums really blew up over it.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: From what I understand, she took responsibility and took her own life.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: Apparently, Yoyo straight-up confessed to Anis that she killed Riss.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: So Anis lost it and beat her to a pulp.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Wait, what? Yoyo did what?

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: ... Hang on, that's weird. Can a Nikke even kill a human?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: No, they can't.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: So how did she manage to kill her?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: It was a lie.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: According to Yoyo, she did break into the manager's place to hurt her.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: But by then, it was already too late. And she's the one who reported the body.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: She says she just slipped the glasses into her pocket without thinking, but that's hardly the point.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: So why'd she lie to Anis?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: She wasn't about to go down alone, obviously.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: T.T. STAR was set to hit the mainstream right after that show.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: So if she caused a scene right there? Of course, everything would have fallen apart.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Wow, that's kinda scary. Do people actually go that far?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: People get scary when they're cornered.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: So what's next for T.T. STAR?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: A comeback's probably not happening. Given the circumstances, she probably won't do any time,

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: but her career as a pop star is over.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: T.T. STAR will likely disband.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: And right before their big debut, too. Talk about timing.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: All right, we'll leave it there for this story.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: That's because there's actually something even bigger coming up, right?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: Yes, something major happened at Tetra Line.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: Big enough to shake the entire company.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: If you destroy that thing in your hand, I die.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: That'd solve all your problems, wouldn't it?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: No, you and Tetra Line are vital to the Ark.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: If anything were to happen to you, it would collapse.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: And what, exactly, makes you think you can tell me to die?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I'll do it.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I'll become Mustang.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: In summary, you are requesting a change of identity to Tetra Line's CEO, Mustang. Is that correct?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Yes, that's correct.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Mustang, CEO of Tetra Line, is currently classified as a systemic malignancy within the Ark. However, removal is not feasible.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Therefore, the current Mustang will be eliminated, and you, his son, will assume his identity.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: This action will resolve the malignant condition within the Ark.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: On a computational level, the task is simple. However, the matter does not end there.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I know as much about Tetra Line as Mustang does.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: No, I know more.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Requesting permission to verify.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Yes, certainly.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: The questioning will span several days.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: That's fine. Please proceed.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Ohh, I see now! So that's your play...!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You're going to become Mustang and run Tetra Line yourself?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Right, of course! You know Tetra inside out!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: In the Ark, identity manipulation is easy enough...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: And you're my son, so you even resemble me!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: So what, you're going to imitate me, my voice, and my mannerisms?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: That's correct.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Haha! You think you can be me?!

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: It's fortunate that you've already established such a clear persona.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Haha! Of course, no one pulls off a persona like I do!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: But there's no way they'll miss the differences, wouldn't you agree?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: We can just pass it off as a new and improved version of you.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Haha! Yes, yes, that's exactly my style! Perfect!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: So what happens to Hanson, then?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: If you become Mustang, where does that leave him?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Hanson will die

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: and cease to exist in this world.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: So that's it? You're gonna spend the rest of your life as Mustang, and Hanson's just gone for good?!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You really think you can live like that?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I can.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I've learned how to wear a mask well enough.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Heh... hahaha!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: So what's your move with Tetra, huh?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You don't pull off something this crazy without a plan!

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I will turn it into a true entertainment company,

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: because you don't entertain.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: You don't make people smile,

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: nor do you give them hope.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: That's entertainment, you idiot.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You can't give anyone joy without a little misery first.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: No, I don't think that's the case.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Entertainment is meant to bring joy to everyone. That's what it's all about.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You're dreaming.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Look at the Ark. It's nothing but a cesspool.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: A place full of people who can't be happy unless someone else is miserable.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: There are more good people in the Ark than you think.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: It's for them that Pretty became a star.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You really think you can pull it off?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I can do it, and I will.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: That answer doesn't sit well with me.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: And you think I'd just hand over Mustang to you?
Hanson steps closer to Mustang.
He leans in, his voice dropping to a near whisper.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I thought you might not like it.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: don't you find it amusing?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Your son will inherit your company and spend his life imitating you.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Amusing, isn't it?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Enough to die for.
Mustang snatches the device from Hanson's hand
and hurls it at the wall. It shatters on impact, spraying liquid everywhere.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Entertainment!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Fun! This is insanely fun!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Absolutely fun!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Hah! Go on, try and top this!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: That "entertainment brings joy to everyone" nonsense you keep yapping about! Let's see you actually pull it off!

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: And when I do, I'll spit on your grave.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Haha!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Just as I thought...!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You really are my son!

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: Elysion and Missilis have released a large batch of files exposing Tetra Line's corruption.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: Some of the material is almost unbelievable in its severity.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: It begins with relatively minor issues like unfair contracts, systemic abuse, chart manipulation, and hidden funds...

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: But it quickly escalates to human experimentation, illegal Nikke conversions, and even contract killings.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Huh? Where'd this evil corporation come from all of a sudden?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: They're getting hammered from all sides right now, and their stock's hit rock bottom.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: Meanwhile, Elysion and Missilis are on the rise. But that's just my take, so take it with a grain of salt.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: So where does that leave Tetra Line, then?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: Tetra Line's CEO, Mustang, hasn't issued any kind of response so far.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: Even for him, this isn't something he can just brush off... Hang on. What's this?

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Oh, looks like we've got some breaking news coming in.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Let's see...

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: This just in,

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Hanson, a director at Tetra Line, was found dead this afternoon.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: He was discovered in his car.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Well, this is kind of unfortunate timing.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: Looks like they'll pin everything on him.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: That's a bit risky to say, isn't it?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: I saw that coming, so no surprise there.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: It's not exactly interesting, so let's move on.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: How intéressant! I never pegged you two for the silent type, non?

lines.speaker: elysionline0_op_l
lines.text: What are you trying to pull?

lines.speaker: missilisline0_op_r
lines.text: What, is this some kind of joke?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Do we have a problème, hmm?

lines.speaker: elysionline0_op_l
lines.text: That's not even the half of it.

lines.speaker: elysionline0_op_l
lines.text: And now you're trying to imitate Mustang, Hanson?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Mon dieu! I haven't the faintest idée what you're talking about!

lines.speaker: missilisline0_op_r
lines.text: I'm talking about you. Are you serious right now? What do you think you're doing?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Now then, écoute bien... Listen up, oui?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Je suis Mustang,

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: the one and only CEO of Tetra Line.

lines.speaker: missilisline0_op_r
lines.text: Look, insisting on it isn't gonna make it happen.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Our dear Hanson, now quitté from this world, told me everything about you two, mes amis.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: And oui, I know all about the little deal you struck with him.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: En échange for granting Hanson's wish...

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Tetra Line will withdraw its support from the Second Surface Reclamation War, bien sûr.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: And all rewards go to Elysion and Missilis. Très généreux, non?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: From this point on, Tetra Line se devote itself entirely to entertainment and only entertainment. Rien d'autre.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: We won't so much as glance elsewhere.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Ohh, so the Ark will become le world of Elysion et Missilis? How délicieux!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: A real pity, but a deal is un deal, and it was mon cher Hanson who proposed it. So of course, I shall honor it. Jusqu'au bout!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Is there any problème with the deal?

lines.speaker: elysionline0_op_l
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: missilisline0_op_r
lines.text: Sounds good to me. I'll play along.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Ah, parfait! Then I shall pose a question, mes amis.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Tell me, who am I?

lines.speaker: elysionline0_op_l
lines.text: Mustang.

lines.speaker: missilisline0_op_r
lines.text: You're Mustang.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Hahaha! Now that's entertainment!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Well then, mes amis,

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: take good care of me from here on, d'accord?
